sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: You have got to be kidding me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels openly exasperated and incredulous, with a burst of frustrated panic at her bad luck on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... move already.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s impatient and stressed from being delayed, with a frustrated urgency that’s turning into a determined push to get through the crowd.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. It's fine. New term, fresh start, and I'm sweating before homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to talk herself into staying upbeat, but underneath the joking words she feels flustered, stressed, and embarrassed about already being in a mess on the first day.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and urgently determined, pushing through the crowd with embarrassed energy while trying to stay upbeat and get to class on time.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: Breathless and relieved, with a burst of triumphant energy after barely making it on time.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She freezes in sudden embarrassment and awkward surprise, realizing she has burst into the wrong room and been caught by everyone’s attention at once.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels abruptly embarrassed and flustered, trying to recover her composure with a tentative, hopeful question after realizing she may have rushed into the wrong classroom.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Right! Great! Love that for me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and embarrassed by the mistake, but is forcing a bright, joking front to recover her composure and keep from looking flustered.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from the mistaken classroom entrance, but trying to recover with upbeat, socially smooth energy and a forced confidence.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously? You may have just saved my life.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels intensely relieved and grateful, with a burst of embarrassed humor as she clings to the help that just rescued her from an even bigger first-day disaster.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Here! Present. Very present. Extremely sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed from her string of mishaps, but is trying to recover with upbeat, self-aware humor and a determined eagerness to make a good impression.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: I can't believe that happened before nine in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and overwhelmed, but is also half-amused and relieved that the morning chaos is finally over.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Recovered? I entered the wrong class like I was making a dramatic entrance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s embarrassed but laughing at herself, turning the mistake into a joke to show she’s already shaken it off and feels a little relieved.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Then I'll call it confidence and not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s joking herself back into composure, turning embarrassment into playful self-assurance and trying to frame the whole mess as a funny win instead of a humiliating mistake.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Hey, since I already embarrassed myself in front of half the first years... want to stick together at lunch?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish about her earlier blunder but is now relaxed, grateful, and warmly hopeful, using humor and openness to turn an awkward morning into a budding friendship.
sprite_sequence.label: smile
